high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "itskaywithme," which has a verified badge indicated by a blue checkmark next to the username. The post features a person standing on a rooftop with a cityscape in the background. The individual is wearing a white, loose-fitting top that is partially unbuttoned, revealing a portion of their midriff. They have long, wavy hair and are accessorized with earrings, bracelets, and rings. The person appears to be posing with one hand touching their hair and the other resting on the brick edge of the rooftop.
